banner: scank - scalability test. Only test sites you own or have written permission to test.
guard.invalid: Invalid URL. Use http:// or https://
guard.notOwner: Remote site. Add --confirm-owner to confirm you own it or have written permission.

verdict.PASS: PASS: the site held up in this test.
verdict.WARNING: WARNING: the site held up, but with slow responses or some errors.
verdict.FAIL: FAIL: the site broke under load.
